whyDubai.title: A City Built for Growth
whyDubai.lead: One of the world's most dynamic, secure and connected cities, Dubai offers the stability, lifestyle and returns that make ownership genuinely rewarding.
whyDubai.r1Text: No income tax and no annual property tax on residential real estate.
whyDubai.r2Text: Among the highest gross rental returns of any major global city.
whyDubai.r3Text: Long-term residency for property investors and their families.
whyDubai.r4Text: Consistently ranked among the safest cities in the world.
whyDubai.r5Text: Within an eight-hour flight of two-thirds of the world's population.
whyDubai.r6Text: Full foreign ownership across Dubai's freehold communities.
